title: BADGR: The Berkeley Autonomous Driving Ground Robot
summary: A learned predictive model supports self-supervised robot navigation without human-labeled data. The primary v1 reports repeated indoor and off-road goal-reaching trials after about 42 hours of robot experience; results are limited to the reported platform and routes.
ai_technology: Self-supervised learned predictive model for goal-directed ground-robot navigation
organization: Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR), University of California, Berkeley

evidence.tested: The primary v1 reports repeated navigation trials on indoor and off-road routes after about 42 hours of robot experience.
evidence.unknown: No independent replication; results are limited to the reported robot and routes.
evidence.ai_role: An end-to-end learned predictive model estimates action outcomes from self-supervised real-robot interaction and supports navigation.

source_review.scope: Primary arXiv v1 full text, Methods and Results; first-version date checked.
